notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's glue module is the shared pre-world screen vocabulary - the GlueArt asset set, ADD-mode UI material, backdrop fitting, widget/outline builders - i.e. rendering scaffolding for char-select/create. MSUI draws the same screens through its own scaffolding: GlueScene renders the UI_MainMenu / UI_<Race> M2 scenes, GlueBooth poses the geared preview character, and WowSkin + GlueImageUv provide the skinned chrome/art. The observable screens themselves are judged under systems/char_select and systems/char_create.
